tagline: 康泰时胶片单反相机，2002 年发布
description: 康泰时于2002年推出的胶片单反相机。快门速度AV, TV and P: 32 to 1/4000 sec.; M: 32 to 1/4000 sec. and bulb; X: 1/125 sec. (M mode)。使用Auto load, advance and rewind with built-in motor. Up to 2.3 fps. in C mode.。感光度Auto with DX-coded film, 25 to 5000 ISO; manual setting, 6 to 6400 ISO。5-point TTL phase difference detection。

specs.快门速度: AV, TV and P: 32 to 1/4000 sec.; M: 32 to 1/4000 sec. and bulb; X: 1/125 sec. (M mode)
specs.曝光测光: Aperture, shutter, program auto, manual and TTL auto priority modes
specs.感光度: Auto with DX-coded film, 25 to 5000 ISO; manual setting, 6 to 6400 ISO
specs.取景器: eye-level pentaprism with 93% Field of view and 0.78x magnification (50mm lens at inf.)
specs.胶片/画幅: Auto load, advance and rewind with built-in motor. Up to 2.3 fps. in C mode.
specs.英文简介: The Contax NX is an autofocus 35mm film SLR camera introduced in 2002 by Kyocera.
